purpose: Post-training diagnosis on every literal user-commented ply. This diagnostic corpus cannot select or promote an actor and is opened only after authoritative full-match selection is complete.

authoritative_final_actor_contract.selection_modes: no_challenge mechanically carries forward the fully revalidated archived world winner when no later method qualified for a final comparison; component_final binds a distinct component challenger to either its standard locked_reciprocal_actor_gate_decision or the match-value-specific match_value_reserved_final_gate; composition_final binds a distinct composed challenger to the standard gate and a strictly revalidated locked_composition_pre_efficacy_manifest.
authoritative_final_actor_contract.selection: The result records winner_actor and complete actor asset hashes, but the launch helper independently derives them. For either real final comparison, audit the challenger only when every raw-valid, zero-cap final-gate requirement passed and otherwise audit its distinct reference. no_challenge needs no fake failed gate and permits winner==reference only because no challenger qualified.

candidate_rule: Union of each actor's top-three complete semantic policy moves, capped at five. Physical wager IDs are deduplicated but draw sources remain distinct. Never enumerate rollout values for every legal move.
world_model: Uniform hidden-card determinizations shared by every admitted move and reproducible across actors. Complete ordered hidden support replaces sampling in sufficiently small late states and the report records requested and actual support.
continuation: Each actor's production continuation checkpoint and role schedule, with exact one-card endings, semantic cycle handling, and cap-reserve completion.
belief_diagnostics: The two belief-only complaints spend no action-rollout worlds. They report both comparison actors' snapshot-only fixed-cardinality marginals and a separate actor-aware posterior from the frozen perspective history at exactly 20000 worlds.

shards.coverage: Each shard receives exactly three cases, yielding all 36 cases once.

build.binding: Preflight compiles once, records the full compiler banner and runner platform, hashes the complete evaluator transport, and every shard and merge job verifies that transport without a checkout or compiler.

execution.prepare_command: python3 tools/flagged_ply_execution.py prepare-execution --root . --execution data/flagged_ply_audit_execution.json --source-parent-commit $(git rev-parse HEAD) --source-parent-tree $(git rev-parse HEAD^{tree})
execution.launch_commit: After the authoritative final result is committed, run the prepare command without editing its output, then make one direct-parent commit that adds only the canonical execution file and push it once to agent/correctness-and-policy-upgrade.
execution.guard: No workflow_dispatch exists. The first run attempt rejects force pushes, merge commits, non-direct parents, branch drift, any launch-commit path other than the one new regular execution blob, any prior execution-file history, and any byte drift in the plan, workflow, manifest, tools, corpus artifacts, actor models/tables, authoritative results, source parent, or tree.

reporting: The complete artifact retains all 12 immutable shard JSON files, the lossless merged JSON, deterministic per-ply Markdown, execution/plan/workflow/manifest/final-result bindings, compiler/platform metadata, evaluator hashes, and a final checksum manifest.
